messages:
Alex: Quick ask — can we add a Grafana panel that correlates rack-level network degradation with GPU thermals and fan fallback events? Want to spot cases where packet loss or NIC errors precede inlet temp climb and forced fan escalation so we can route provisioning differently.

Priya: +1. Useful for preemptive slot draining. What metrics do we want visible?

Alex: Minimum: per-rack packet drops/errors, per-node GPU inlet temp (celsius), fan-state transitions (normal -> fallback -> max), and warm-slot / pending-provision queue length. Overlay tenant allocation density if possible.

Mateo: Also include NVLink/PCI retransmits if we can — network issues can show up there. For provisioning behavior: show pending_jobs_by_rack and warm_slot_count.

Priya: Agree. Layout idea: top row time-series (drops, errors, retransmits) stacked; middle row thermal heatmap by rack; bottom row event log/sparkline for fan fallback counts + pending queue.

observability-bot: PromQL snippets that helped in a quick spike triage earlier:
```
# per-rack packet drops / 5m
sum by (rack) (increase(node_network_receive_dropped_total[5m]))

# gpu inlet temp avg per rack
avg by (rack) (gpu_inlet_temp_celsius)

# fan fallback events (count)
sum by (rack) (increase(gpu_fan_fallback_events_total[10m]))
```

Lina: Proposal for an alert: fire a composite when: packet_drop_rate > 1000/5m for rack AND avg_inlet_temp > 70C AND fan_fallback_events >= 2 in last 10m. Mark severity P1 and create a runbook link.

Alex: That sounds right. Also want a lower-severity signal: if pending_provisioning_queue > threshold and avg_temp > 65C then start aggressive warm-sloting in adjacent racks.

Mateo: UX ask: make rack grouping selectable (by region, pod, or custom tag). We'll need a variable for $rack_group. Also add an annotation stream for recent capacity changes (scale-up/scale-down commits).

Priya: I'll put together the panel JSON and a Grafana storyboard. Will include a table view with recent fan fallback events and the tenant IDs linked to allocations.

Priya: draft queries and panel layout uploaded to grafana-dev. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/DEV123/rack-therm-net (dev only) :mag: 

Mateo: I can review tonight. Will add a note to transform GPU labels to normalize device_id -> short form.

Alex: Thanks — can we also put a small per-rack cost estimate column? If throttles start, cost-per-token spikes, want immediate visibility.

observability-bot: Example cost overlay (pseudo):
```
# cost estimate per rack (tokens/min * unit_cost)
sum by (rack) (rate(generated_tokens_total[1m]) * on() rack_unit_price_usd)
```

Lina: Runbook bits: add steps: 1) check network switch counters 2) verify NIC firmware 3) fallback to adjacent rack routing 4) consider temporary tenant throttles. I'll draft the playbook and link it in the alert.

ops-bot: deploybot: Saved dashboard to grafana-dev (uid=dev-rack-net-therm-001) and created PR #6789 for review in infra-dashboards repo.

Alex: Great — @Priya @Mateo ping me once PR is ready and I'll do a quick UX pass. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Priya: will do — ETA for PR: today EOD.

Mateo: reviewing after stand.

Lina: I'll add the runbook link to the alert in the PR.

Alex: Awesome. If we see any reproduction from the canary, we'll iterate on thresholds.
